title: Active and Passive Voice - Rules and Transformations

questions.question: What is the basic structure of Passive Voice?
options: Subject + Helping Verb + Main Verb + Object
Object + Helping Verb + V3 + by + Subject
questions.rationale: Passive Voice structure is: Object + Helping Verb + V3 + by + Subject — the object of the active sentence becomes the subject.

questions.question: What is the Passive structure for Present Indefinite Tense?
questions.rationale: Present Indefinite Passive uses: is/am/are + V3 (past participle).

questions.question: How is a Request converted for the Passive/Imperative special structure?
options: You are ordered to + V1 + Object
You are requested to + V1 + Object
You are advised to + V1 + Object
questions.rationale: For Request-type imperatives, the structure is: You are requested to + V1 + Object.

questions.question: What is the Passive structure for Past Continuous Tense?
questions.rationale: Past Continuous Passive uses: was/were + being + V3, as opposed to the Active form was/were + V1+ing.
